name: report_check
description: Report whether the question and answer work as a way of showing learning, correcting them when a change would make them work.

verdict.description: works when the pair works as it is; fixable when a change to the question or the answer would make it work; beyond_repair when no change would; unsure when you cannot tell

task.description: The corrected task, only when the verdict is fixable. Change only what keeps the pair from working.

answer.description: The corrected answer, only when the verdict is fixable. Carry the original answer unchanged if only the task needed correction.
